text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, Suzuka-san! Would you like to 
have dinner together tonight?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my mom sent me a whole bunch of 
carrots for my birthday!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll be delivered to the dorm 
later, so if you'd like, would you join me 
for a carrot party—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Spe-chan. I have plans tonight, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm terribly sorry. You see, we've all 
promised to celebrate Spe-chan's birthday 
together."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I-Is that so? No, it's fine. If it's 
Spe-chan's birthday, it can't be 
helped..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone is waiting. Let's go, 
Spe-chan.
